title: Marlowe Rewards Benefit Schedule: Refund Availability Periods for Gift Cards & Store Credit Cash-Outs
content:
The refund availability period of a Gift Cards & Store Credit cash-out (the number of calendar days after the most recent refund loaded onto the instrument from an order paid with it before refunded value becomes payable) follows the holder's Marlowe Rewards standing on the cash-out date.

## Schedule

| Marlowe Rewards tier on the cash-out date | Membership enrolled at least | Refund availability period |
|---|---|---|
| Gold, Platinum, Icon or Atelier | 36 whole months earlier | 7 calendar days |
| Silver | 12 whole months earlier | 9 calendar days |
| Any other tier or tenure, or no membership | — | Not shortened by Marlowe Rewards standing |

Tier and enrolment date are read from the holder's Marlowe Rewards membership; tenure is counted in whole months from the enrolment date to the cash-out date.

## Both conditions together (hypothetical holders)

| Tier | Whole months since enrolment | Period under this schedule |
|---|---|---|
| Gold | 36 | 7 calendar days |
| Gold | 35 | Not shortened |
| Platinum | 12 | Not shortened (12 months is below 36, and the Silver line is for Silver members only) |
| Silver | 40 | 9 calendar days |
| Silver | 11 | Not shortened |
| Member (entry tier) | 50 | Not shortened |

## On the calendar (hypothetical most recent refund dated 1 June, period of 7 days)

The refund's date is day zero: the refunded value is still held on 7 June (day 6) and becomes payable on 8 June (day 7).
